correctness.rationale: Both Calkin-Wilf child transformations are bijective on projective residues, preserve primitive pairs, and invert into one another. Complete direct state transition tables and inversion symmetry give exact 3x3/4x4 transfer matrices, with rational generating functions proved for every depth. Their eigenvalues are respectively 2,(-1±i√7)/2 and 2,-1,(1±i√7)/2. Explicit decomposition of zero-class counts gives amplitudes 2/√14 and 1/√7; irrationality of each phase follows because 2cos(2θ)=-3/2 is not an algebraic integer. The finite verifier recomputes all states at depth≤15 and GF coefficients through n=80 in exact integer arithmetic; this is corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: An exact higher-modulus refinement of the canonical Calkin-Wilf parity partition, at the first two odd primes. It determines complete 4- and 6-class statistics at every tree level, identifies the first level when all fractions directions occur, and proves surprisingly sharp √2 spectral oscillations with two distinct nonzero limiting constants. The result has an infinite structural proof rather than merely a finite count.
